C-KAFEDRA-AI-SKILLS-PROFILE-288.Summary: Vendor the verified Kafedra Planner document-workspace skills profile and make its orchestrator the mandatory project-local routing preflight for future development.
C-KAFEDRA-AI-SKILLS-PROFILE-288.Problem: The reusable Kafedra document-workspace profile exists in ai-agents-skills but kafedra-planner does not yet pin, validate, or automatically route future work through it. Agents can therefore miss document-workspace invariants or depend on external/global installation state.

Goals.Goal: Vendor the exact verified profile snapshot from f2re/ai-agents-skills at 2645ab8afd34963e80397981d582ea3b141db8e3.
Make kafedra-workspace-orchestrator an explicit mandatory routing preflight in repository-local AGENTS.md for substantial development.
Integrate focused profile handoffs into the existing kafedra-* specialist chain without creating a competing authority hierarchy.
Fail closed in npm run check when pinned profile files, source provenance, routing markers, or role handoffs drift.
Keep the integration development-only and fully usable without Internet, LLM, Docker, or runtime package changes.

Constraints.Constraint: Project-local AGENTS.md, GRACE contracts, architecture/design/UX documents and existing kafedra-* roles remain authoritative over reusable profile guidance.
No production UI, API, worker, storage, SQLite schema, migration, VERSION, package dependency or runtime/offline service behavior may change.
The vendored SKILL.md files must remain byte-identical to their pinned upstream Git blobs.
The orchestrator selects only relevant focused skills; future backend/infrastructure work may explicitly route to no focused profile skill.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Introduce a runtime dependency on ai-agents-skills or automatically pull upstream changes.
Replace GRACE or the existing project-local specialist roles.
Change database, release version, permissions, or user-visible domain behavior.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All 14 required Kafedra profile skills are present repository-locally and match the pinned upstream Git blob SHAs.
AGENTS.md requires kafedra-workspace-orchestrator after repository inspection and before substantial design/implementation.
docs/CODEX_AGENTS.md and existing specialist roles define project-first handoffs to focused profile skills without changing authority.
A deterministic validator runs through npm run check and fails on missing skills, changed snapshot bytes, wrong upstream metadata, missing routing markers, or missing role handoffs.
Profile provenance and a governed snapshot update procedure are documented.
Full GRACE, project CI, release/offline/database gates succeed on one exact PR head and post-merge main.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The repository carries an exact pinned profile snapshot and all substantial future work enters through project-local Kafedra routing without a runtime/network dependency.
